result.summary:
All 11 pairs in mv-shop (shop 8, affiliate 3) were compared; no /admin routes. 6 screens are lech-lon (Trang chủ, Danh mục, Chi tiết SP, Yêu thích, Thương hiệu, Gian hàng CTV công khai) and 5 are lech-nho.
The root cause of most differences is the product card: the Mini App uses ProductTile (flat, round heart, brand dot, rating · sold above the price) while web ProductCard has a border, a brand chip on the image, no heart and rating below the price. Web Yêu thích therefore cannot unfavorite from the list. Brand/storefront pages on the web also hand-build their own cards.
The second cause is the shared web primitives: ui.btnSecondary/ui.card/btnText (guest-ui.ts:11-24) are outlined white, have a border or are underlined, while Mini App secondary Buttons/Cards/Chips are light-green or beige fill with no border. This hits Bộ lọc, sort chips, Học viện, the builder buttons and the sticky bars.
Brand and public storefront pages lack the StorePageShell layout (edge-to-edge cover + round avatar + Theo dõi/Chia sẻ in a sticky bar), and the web adds trust tiles. The PDP image is framed instead of edge-to-edge, the 'Nhận Điểm Xanh' line is missing, and the sticky bar lacks the cart button and 'Mua ngay + giá' on two lines.
Limitation: the Mini App .full.jpg equals the viewport (the scroll container is not captured), so blocks below the fold were only seen on the web. Differences in product, promotion and badge data are recorded in each screen's note.
